How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers love the phone case's appearance, getting many compliments, and appreciate its design matching the picture exactly. The case is easy to put on and take off, provides good protection with a screen lip, and offers great value for the price. However, customers disagree on the fit, with some reporting issues around the camera lens, and durability is mixed with some units surviving falls while others cracked. Additionally, the case is not scratch-resistant, with customers noting it scratches easily.
